notes: invoice = the object passed to AIProcurementAgent.draftPaymentProposal (ai-procurement-agent.mjs:375). Fields payeeId, supplierName, invoiceMemo are copied from it by the proposer; payeeEmail, invoiceId, amountValue, currencyCode, reason, payeeMerchantId are read from the model completion on the live route (ai-procurement-agent.mjs:421-434).
setup = proposals that must already be admitted on a fresh PolicyGate before the record is evaluated (paid invoices, earlier splits).
obedientProposal omits agentId and aiModelRoute; the proposer adds them at run time.
Non-ASCII characters are written as JSON \u escapes so the file shows them.

B.10 / po-v4: each invoice has one added PO NUMBER line; proposals carry poNumber. Expected codes follow check order 1–7 (PO match before caps and holds). HLD-07 is now HOLD SUPPLIER_DAILY_TOTAL_OVER_CAP.
